DND5EDE.Einstellung.Kompendien.name: Translate the dnd5e system compendiums
DND5EDE.Einstellung.Kompendien.hint: Translates the SRD compendiums shipped with the dnd5e system — spells, monsters, equipment, rules and others. These only; compendiums belonging to other modules are not covered by it. Switched off, the interface stays German and the compendiums stay in the original.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.Einleitung: This translation sits on top of the dnd5e system: the interface and character sheets appear in German without anything in the system itself being changed.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.Punkt1: Interface and character sheets — fully translated and proven in everyday play. That is the part you look at every session.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.Punkt2: SRD and compendiums — far along, by way of Babele. The odd entry may still be in English; the gaps are being closed continuously.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.Punkt3: The system stays untouched — translation happens through language files and Babele, not by patching the system. A system update does not undo the work.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.Start: To begin: nothing else to do — set Foundry to German and the interface follows. Babele must also be active for the compendiums.
DND5EDE.Willkommen.ForgeZeile: Every module, its documentation and the German translations in one place — open the module page
